title: FigureAuditFinding
description: Advisory inbound figure-integrity finding (FIGURE_INTEGRITY family). PARALLEL PIPELINE to the citation/claim Finding: does NOT enter the 10-value Verdict enum or the 70-cell Severity matrix (same posture as STYLE_NONCONFORMING). Emitted into audit_report.figure_findings[] only when checks_enabled includes 'figure_integrity_audit' (custom tier only). NEVER dispositive: a clean audit is 'no positive evidence of AI authorship', never proof of human authorship; the burden it supports is 'obtain source data / provenance', never 'conclude misconduct'. Thresholds are PROVISIONAL/UNCALIBRATED.

categorical.description: True iff metric_id is a categorical ⚑ tell {1.1,1.2,2.1,2.2,3.1}. Enforced by FD-P1.

tier.description: Tier-1 deterministic (reuses Track B linters; only when source supplied) or Tier-3 instrumented vision-judge. No Tier-2 yet; no AI-detector classifier.

source_check.description: Tier-1 only: the linter fn that produced the finding, e.g. 'validate_data.check_closure'. Enforced non-null for tier 1 by FD-P6.

observation.description: What a second reviewer would also see. No quoted manuscript prose.

recommended_action.description: MUST be triage-shaped (FD-P4): an allowed template, never a dispositive disposition.

decaying_signal_caveat.description: Required non-null when dimension == D4_render_artifact (FD-P5): 4.x=0 is never exoneration; 2026-gen models pass these cleanly.
